function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL and retrieves data as specified by the parameters. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The URL to which the GET request is sent. It is expected to be a well-formed HTTP or HTTPS URL.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: The Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

headers.description: A dictionary of HTTP headers to send with the request. Each key-value pair represents a header name and its value.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up, as a float, or a (connect_timeout, read_timeout) tuple. This is a float type value.

lat.description: Latitude of the location for the query, in degrees. This is a float type value.

lon.description: Longitude of the location for the query, in degrees. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters to append to the URL for the GET request.

allow_redirects.description: Determines if HTTP redirections (301, 302, etc.) should be followed.

auth.description: A tuple representing the user credentials for HTTP authentication, typically in the form of (username, password).

cert.description: Path to an SSL certificate file to verify the peer, or a tuple of (certificate file, key file).

cookies.description: A dictionary of cookies to send with the request. The key is the cookie name and the value is the cookie value.

http.description: URL of the proxy for HTTP requests.

https.description: URL of the proxy for HTTPS requests.

proxies.description: A dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy.

stream.description: If True, the response content will not be downloaded immediately but streamed.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate or not, or a path to a CA bundle if verification is needed.

Sure thing! Here’s a quick guide to help you find the perfect place to order a cake—whether you’re looking for a local bakery, a national chain, or an online specialty shop.

---

## 1. Local Bakeries (Best for Freshness & Customization)

| City / Region | Bakery | What Makes Them Stand Out | How to Order |
|---------------|--------|---------------------------|--------------|
| **New York** | *Dominique Ansel Bakery* | Famous for creative pastries & custom cakes. | Call or order online via their website. |
| **Los Angeles** | *Baked* | Organic ingredients, vegan options. | Order through their app or website. |
| **Chicago** | *The Sweet Spot* | Classic Chicago-style cakes, quick delivery. | Phone or online order. |
| **London** | *The Cake Shop* | Traditional British cakes, same‑day delivery. | Book online or call. |
| **Sydney** | *Baker & Co.* | Freshly baked, gluten‑free options. | Order online or by phone. |

> **Tip:** Search “best local bakery near me” on Google Maps or Yelp. Look for recent reviews and photos of their cakes.

---

## 2. National Chains & Specialty Stores

| Brand | What They Offer | Delivery Options |
|-------|-----------------|------------------|
| **T.G.I. Friday’s** | Classic birthday cakes, custom messages. | Order online; delivery via their own service or third‑party apps. |
| **Dunkin’** | Quick, affordable cakes, often with a “Dunkin’” twist. | Order through the Dunkin’ app or website. |
| **Panera Bread** | Freshly baked cakes, healthier options. | Order online; delivery via Uber Eats or DoorDash. |
| **Cakes.com** | Custom cakes, themed designs. | Order online; delivery nationwide. |
| **Goldbelly** | Curated selection from top U.S. bakeries. | Order online; delivery across the U.S. |

> **Pro Tip:** If you’re ordering a themed cake (e.g., superhero, sports team), check the brand’s “custom cake” section first.

---

## 3. Online Specialty Shops (Nationwide & International)

| Shop | Highlights | Shipping |
|------|------------|----------|
| **Goldbelly** | 200+ bakeries, unique regional flavors. | Nationwide U.S. shipping; some international. |
| **BakeShop** | Custom cakes, seasonal specials. | U.S. only. |
| **Etsy** | Handmade, artisanal cakes from independent bakers. | Varies by seller; many offer shipping. |
| **Amazon Fresh** | Ready‑to‑eat cakes, quick delivery. | Same‑day or next‑day delivery in select cities. |
| **HelloFresh** | Cake kits for DIY baking. | U.S. only. |

> **Why Go Online?** Great for specialty flavors (e.g., gluten‑free, vegan, keto) and for ordering from a bakery that doesn’t have a local presence.

---

## 4. Food Delivery Apps (Convenient & Fast)

| App | How It Works | Best For |
|-----|--------------|----------|
| **Uber Eats** | Browse local restaurants & bakeries. | Same‑day delivery in most cities. |
| **DoorDash** | Wide selection of local bakeries. | Quick delivery, sometimes free for orders over a certain amount. |
| **Postmates** | Same as above, plus “Postmates Express” for faster delivery. | Ideal for last‑minute orders. |
| **Grubhub** | Focus on local eateries. | Good for local bakery picks. |

> **Pro Tip:** Many apps let you filter by “cakes” or “desserts.” Check the “specialty” or “premium” sections for higher‑quality options.

---

## 5. Grocery Stores & Supermarkets

| Store | What They Offer | Delivery |
|-------|-----------------|----------|
| **Whole Foods** | Freshly baked cakes, organic options. | Same‑day delivery via Amazon Prime. |
| **Trader Joe’s** | Seasonal cakes, pre‑packaged. | In‑store pickup or local delivery. |
| **Kroger** | Custom cakes, seasonal specials. | Delivery via Kroger Delivery or Instacart. |
| **Safeway** | Fresh cakes, quick pickup. | Same‑day delivery via Instacart. |

> **Why Choose a Grocery Store?** Great for budget‑friendly options and quick pickup if you’re in a hurry.

---

## 6. Tips for Ordering the Perfect Cake

1. **Know Your Deadline** – Most bakeries need 24–48 hrs notice for custom orders.  
2. **Specify Flavor & Size** – Clarify the number of servings, dietary restrictions, and any special decorations.  
3. **Check Reviews** – Look for recent photos and comments about taste, freshness, and delivery reliability.  
4. **Ask About Packaging** – Ensure the cake will be shipped or delivered safely (especially if it’s a multi‑layer or fragile design).  
5. **Confirm Delivery Time** – Some places offer “same‑day” or “next‑day” delivery; confirm the exact window.  
6. **Use Promo Codes** – Many sites offer discount codes or free delivery thresholds (e.g., “$10 off orders over $50”).  

---

### Quick Start: How to Order Right Now

1. **Open your preferred app** (Uber Eats, DoorDash, or your local bakery’s website).  
2. **Search for “cake”** or “birthday cake.”  
3. **Filter by “custom” or “specialty”** if you want a personalized design.  
4. **Select your cake** → add to cart → checkout.  
5. **Enter delivery details** → choose payment → confirm.
